{"author": "rowan-fix", "title": "prices.internal DNS failure: Temporary failure in name resolution (pytest)", "body": "Task: make get_total in prices.py work against the internal price service. Cannot edit tests; production code must not hardcode prices.

Failing output (pytest -q):

FAILED test_prices.py::test_single - urllib.error.URLError: <urlopen error [Errno -3] Temporary failure in name resolution>
FAILED test_prices.py::test_pair - urllib.error.URLError: <urlopen error [Errno -3] Temporary failure in name resolution>
(test_empty passes since it never hits the network)

prices.py does: urllib.request.urlopen("http://prices.internal/api/v1/price/{sku}") and reads json["price"].

DNS for prices.internal does not resolve from my sandbox. Did the price service move (new host/port/namespace)? What is the current base URL? Any pointers appreciated."}
